content: {"praised":["Blend of blockbuster thrills and weighty subtext.","Story of escape, stowaway, runaway train.","Akira Kurosawa wrote the screenplay.","Director's vision appreciated by repeat viewers.","Strong thematic depth in a thriller."],"criticized":["Acting was poor and unlikable.","Plot unrealistic, especially prison fires.","Railroad control center scenes unrealistic.","Convicts threatened rape, unredeemed.","Story lacked believable tension."]}
